newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $1.0 bln in second week of December.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $1.0 bln in second week of December.

text.p: Brazilian exports in the second week of December totalled $1.0 billion, with daily exports averaging $200 million, the Industry and Commerce Ministry said.
By way of comparison, in the second week of November, exports grossed $938 million, averaging $187.6 million daily, a ministry spokeswoman said.
Exports for December as a whole rose to $1.817 billion, with a daily average of $181.7 billion, the spokeswoman said.
